model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е стълбовидна и представя резултатите от различни метрики за разумност на графа в зависимост от качеството на промпта. Хоризонталната ос представлява различни модели - "k-shot" и "zero-shot", подредени по азбучен ред. Вертикалната ос е обозначена като "Branching Ratio γB" и показва стойности в диапазона от 0 до 1, с равномерни интервали от 0,1. Стълбовете са групирани по модел, като всеки модел има два стълба, представляващи "k-shot" и "zero-shot" резултатите. Стълбовете "k-shot" са светлосини, докато стълбовете "zero-shot" са оранжеви. Стойността на "zero-shot" за модела "correct" е около 0,8, докато "k-shot" за модела "correct" е около 0,9. Моделът "incorrect" има стойности около 0,5 за "zero-shot" и около 0,6 за "k-shot". Всички стълбове са придружени от грешки, изобразени като черни линии, простиращи се над стълбовете.
model_annotations.English: Figure 8(c) illustrates the relationship between the branching ratio γB/γ and the number of steps. The horizontal axis, labeled "Number of steps," displays values from 100 to 500 with a regular interval of 100, and is linear. The vertical axis, labeled "Branching Ratio γB/γ", ranges from approximately 0.0000 to 0.0008, with a regular tick label interval of 0.0002, and is linear.  Three lines are presented: a solid blue line representing "Zero-shot PDF," a dashed red line representing "One-shot PDF," and a dash-dot black line representing "Zero-shot CDF." The "Zero-shot PDF" line starts at approximately 0.0002 at 100 steps and rises to approximately 0.0007 at 500 steps. The "One-shot PDF" line begins at about 0.0003 at 100 steps and increases to roughly 0.0008 at 500 steps. The "Zero-shot CDF" line starts at approximately 0.0000 and increases to 0.2 at 500 steps. The lines are not sorted and no bars are visually emphasized.
model_annotations.German: Figure 8(c) presents a bar graph illustrating the ratio γB/γG across different numbers of shots. The horizontal axis represents the number of shots, labeled 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4, with evenly spaced tick marks. The vertical axis, titled "Branching Ratio γB/γG", displays values ranging from 0.00 to 0.70 with tick marks placed at intervals of 0.10.  There are five bars, one for each number of shots—0, 1, 2, 3, and 4—and they appear to be arranged in ascending order by the number of shots. Each bar is light blue in color. The bar corresponding to 0 shots has a height of approximately 0.20, while the bars for 1, 2, 3, and 4 shots have heights of around 0.25, 0.35, 0.50, and 0.60 respectively.  These heights indicate a general increase in the ratio γB/γG as the number of shots increases. No bars are visually distinguished through shading, outlines, or annotations.
